name: Dune Oil Corp.
summary: Dune Oil Corp., an oil and gas exploration company, focuses on the exploration and development of oil and natural gas in Türkiye. It holds interest in M47 Block that covers an area of 450 square kilometer located in Turkiye. The company was formerly known as Trillion Energy International Inc. and changed its name to Dune Oil Corp. in August 2026. Dune Oil Corp. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
